CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
October 7, 2026, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

  RULES OF DECORUM - Click Here to View

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minutes approval  for  September  2,  2026,  Planning  Commission
  meeting.

6.  CONSENT ITEMS:
  a. A one-year review and assessment of SUP23-00031 approved on
  January 10, 2024 to allow 1) large assembly use for an event
  center, 2) shared parking for infrequent users, and 3) the on-
  site consumption of a full line of alcoholic beverages on an
  approximately 25,400 square-foot, C-2 (General Commercial) zoned
  property at 3215 West Manchester Boulevard.

  Recommendation:
  Consider the staff report, any testimony and make a determination.
  It is recommended that you:
  1) Affirm the approval of Resolution No. 1980 dated January 10,
  2024; or
  2) Approve with additional conditions to Resolution No. 1980; or
  3) Revoke SUP23-00031.
  Item 6a Documents

7.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Rick Gunter for
  Special Use Permit No. 26-00021 (SUP26-00021) to allow the
  development of an approximately 146,000 square-foot, six-story
  self-storage building on an approximately 25,600 square-foot,
  M-1 (Light Manufacturing) zoned property at 956 West Hyde Park
  Boulevard.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-107) has been prepared finding
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division Office on
  the fourth floor of City Hall or electronically by request at
  al-martell@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  a. Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-107;
  b. Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00021.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS it is
  recommended to:
  a. Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  a. Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7a Documents
   b. A public hearing to consider an application by Drew Gates for
  Special Use Permit No. 26-00024 (SUP26-00024) to allow the on-
  site sale of beer, wine, and distilled spirits for a proposed
  approximately 10,760 square-foot restaurant that is part of the
  Hollywood Park Tomorrow retail center at 1229 South District
  Drive.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-110) has been prepared finding
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division Office on
  the fourth floor of City Hall or electronically by request at
  al-martell@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  a. Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-110;
  b. Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00024.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS it is
  recommended to:
  a. Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  a. Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7b Documents

8.  PUBLIC COMMENTS.

  Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission on any matter
  within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere considered on the
  agenda may do so at this time.

9.  COMMISSION INITIATIVES.

10.  ADJOURNMENT.

If you will require special accommodations due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of October 7, 2026,
is not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda
item being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda
item will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning
Commission meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 4, 2026, AT 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
